These were Taiping, Ganlan, Dapu and Yongyi. The division gave the upland country its own county administration within the wider Zhaoqing region.

The county's name expressed an official aspiration to widespread tranquillity. An account of the name connects its creation with the suppression of resistance around Daluo Mountain. Guangning's establishment thus belonged to the Ming government's effort to extend administration into a mountainous part of Guangdong. The new county boundary recorded a political decision about how that country should be governed, while the inherited district names preserved connections with the older Sihui jurisdiction.
simp_chinese:
明代，广宁从四会西北的林木山地中分出，成为独立县份。1559年，朝廷划出四会的太平、橄榄、大圃、永义四都设置广宁县，使这片山地拥有自己的县级行政机构，纳入更广阔的肇庆地域。

县名寄托“广泛安宁”的官方愿望。关于名称的记载，将建县与大罗山一带抵抗遭到镇压相联系。因此，广宁的设立属于明朝把行政管理伸入广东山区的过程。新县界体现了如何治理这片土地的政治安排，沿用的都名则保存着它与原四会辖境之间的联系。

english:
Guangping County lay on the plain of southern Hebei, near the Zhang River; the Han had named the district Guangping, 'broad and level'. It was distinct from the prefectural capital at Yongnian. Under the Yuan it belonged to Guangping Circuit; in 1368 the Ming replaced that circuit with Guangping Prefecture. The county's own administrative compound was built in 1369, and an earthen town wall followed during the Tianshun reign, 1457–64.

Defence and flooding repeatedly reshaped this small county seat. The walls were repaired under successive Ming magistrates and rebuilt in brick in 1639. In 1703 the Zhang River overflowed and destroyed the enclosure, forcing the administration to move roughly one li northwest and build a new fortified site. Officials returned to the old site in 1711, again surrounded by earthen walls. The town had eastern, southern and western gates, with a tower on the north. Its public institutions also included a granary west of the county offices, enlarged in 1730.
simp_chinese:
广平县位于河北南部平原，临近漳河，汉代便以“广平”为名，取地势广阔平坦之意。元代属广平路；1368年，明朝将该路改为广平府。县署于1369年建立，天顺年间，即1457至1464年，又修筑土城。

防御和水患反复改变这座小县城的面貌。明代历任知县不断修缮城垣，1639年改筑砖城。1703年漳河泛滥，城墙全部坍毁，县治被迫迁至西北约一里处，另建堡垒。1711年才回到旧址，仍以土墙围护。城开东、南、西三门，北面无门而有楼。县署以西还设预备仓，1730年增建仓廒。

english: Guangshan lay in southeastern Henan, among hills and tributaries draining toward the Huai. Its county gazetteer records changing administrative ties in the early Ming: assignment to Fengyang in 1371 was followed by a return to Runing in 1381. The same work describes a landscape of ponds, weirs and fortified refuges, where local government had to balance cultivation with defence. Qiangong Weir, running around the county town, irrigated several thousand mu of fields. Officials built stone works and assigned residents to guard them, but maintenance repeatedly failed. The gazetteer's author explained the underlying conflict: when spring water threatened neighbouring properties, powerful residents privately breached the works to drain their own land, damaging the water supply on which many other households depended. Repairs therefore involved more than masonry. They required enforcing a shared interest against individual advantage. Such records place Guangshan's history in the practical politics of water, fields and county authority, alongside its position near routes between the Huai basin and central China.
simp_chinese: 光山位于河南东南部，丘陵与支流向淮河流域展开。县志记载，明初当地行政归属有所变化：1371年改属凤阳，1381年又归汝宁。同一部志书还列出众多塘堰及避兵寨堡，呈现出农业经营与防御需求并存的地方环境。环绕县城的千工堰可以灌溉数千亩民田，官员曾筑石加固，并命居民分段守护，但工程屡修屡坏。修志者指出其中的利益冲突：春水上涨时，堰旁一些豪强担心自家受涝，便私自决口排水，却损害了许多其他农户共同依赖的灌溉系统。因此，修堰不只是堆石筑坝，也需要约束为一己便利而破坏公共水利的行为。这些记录将光山的历史落实到水源、农田与县级权力之间的具体关系，也显示出淮河流域边缘聚落的治理难题。

english: Guānsuǒlǐng is a steep mountain pass on the old route between Guizhou and Yunnan. A local tradition associates its name with Guān Suǒ, a legendary follower of the Shu strategist Zhuge Liang. The Ming writer Wáng Shìxìng offered another explanation: travellers used ropes to pass the steep barriers on the ridge, and the name was later understood as that of a deity. The Ming established a defensive thousand-household post at the pass, reflecting its importance to movement through the southwest.
simp_chinese: 关索岭是贵州通往云南古道上的险峻山隘。地方传说将岭名与蜀汉诸葛亮麾下的关索联系起来；明代王士性则记述，岭上关隘高峻，行人须攀索通过，后人误将关索当作神名。明朝在此设守御千户所，可见山岭在西南交通中的重要地位。

english: Guangxi was a prefectural seat in the uplands of southeastern Yunnan, far west of the province that bears the same name. The Yuan established Guangxi Circuit here in the thirteenth century, drawing the neighboring districts of Mile, Shizong and Weimo into its jurisdiction. In 1382 the Ming made it Guangxi Prefecture. Local hereditary officials governed the area until the Ming replaced their rule with appointed officials in the late fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 广西是云南东南高地的一处府治，与更东面的广西省同名。十三世纪，元朝在此设广西路，统辖弥勒、师宗、维摩等地。1382年，明朝改置广西府。当地曾由世袭土官治理，直到十五世纪后期，明朝推行改土归流，转由朝廷派遣官员。

english:
Guangze occupies a mountain basin in northwestern Fujian, on the southwestern side of the Wuyi range near Jiangxi. Its county seat, Hangchuan, stands at the meeting of the Xixi and Beixi streams. These valleys opened a passage through a landscape of enclosing ridges, linking the upper Futun River country with the Fu River basin beyond the provincial boundary.

The settlement's administrative ancestry reaches back to Yangning town, established in 624 and renamed Caiyan in 958. In 979 the Northern Song separated northern Shaowu County to create Guangze County under Shaowu Military Prefecture. By the Yuan period it was therefore already an established county centre. Its name, seat and territorial framework remained remarkably stable through the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties. Shanguan, a pass established in 880 on the Shaowu–Nancheng border, helped make the Nancheng–Shanguan–Shaowu road a principal route between Jiangxi and Fujian. Guangze's historical importance lay in this combination of enduring county institutions and a mountain corridor joining two river systems.
simp_chinese:
光泽位于福建西北部、武夷山西南侧的山间盆地，邻接江西。县治杭川坐落在西溪与北溪汇流之处。周围山脊环抱，河谷则向外延伸，将富屯溪上游同省界另一侧的抚河流域联系起来，形成穿越闽赣山地的通道。

当地行政建置可追溯至624年设置的洋宁镇，958年改称财演镇。979年，北宋析邵武县北部设光泽县，隶属邵武军；因此在元代以前，这里已经是延续数百年的县级中心。元、明、清时期，县名、治所及辖境保持稳定。880年设置于邵武与南城交界的杉关，也让南城—杉关—邵武一线的重要性逐渐上升，成为江西往返福建的主要道路之一。光泽的历史特色，既在于山间县治的长期延续，也在于这条连接不同水系的通道：山岭分隔两省，少数河谷和关口却使人员、官文与货物能够穿行其间。

english: Guangzong lies on the northern Chinese plain, amid old river courses and cultivated fields. The county appears in histories of the Yellow Turban rebellion at the end of the Han: Zhang Jue and his followers withdrew to Guangzong as imperial forces pursued them. Later gazetteers preserved the memory of the old city and its rivers, placing this quiet plain within the story of a great uprising.
simp_chinese: 广宗位于华北平原，旧河道与田地交错。东汉末年黄巾起义的史书中记载，张角等人在官军追击下退守广宗。后世方志仍记述古城与河流，使这片平原与那场波及广大的起义相连。

english: The Guaniguanico range extends across western Cuba, its wooded mountains and limestone hills rising above the surrounding lowlands. It includes the Sierra de los Órganos to the west and the Sierra del Rosario to the east. The name appears in early accounts of Indigenous districts of the island. In the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries coffee estates spread into the Sierra del Rosario, among the mountain valleys and slopes.
simp_chinese: 瓜尼瓜尼科山系横贯古巴西部，森林覆盖的山地与石灰岩丘陵高出周围低地。山系包括西面的奥尔加诺斯山脉和东面的罗萨里奥山脉。岛屿原住民地区的早期记载中已有这一名称。十八世纪末至十九世纪初，咖啡庄园扩展到罗萨里奥山脉的山谷与坡地。

english: Guanima, later known as Cat Island, is a long island in the central Bahamas. Its Lucayan name has been interpreted as the land of the middle waters. The Lucayans lived here before the Spanish slave raids that emptied the islands of much of their population in the sixteenth century. After the American Revolution, loyalist settlers arrived and established plantations on the island.
simp_chinese: 瓜尼玛后来被称为猫岛，是巴哈马中部的一座狭长岛屿。它的卢卡扬名称被解释为“中间水域之地”。卢卡扬人曾住在这里，十六世纪西班牙奴隶掠夺使群岛失去了大部分人口。美国独立战争后，保皇派移民来到岛上，建立了种植园。

english: Guanimar is an early name associated with the bay of Matanzas on Cuba's northern coast. Its sheltered waters meet the mouths of rivers descending from the interior. Bartolomé de las Casas recorded an encounter here before the Spanish conquest, when Indigenous people attacked survivors of a Spanish shipwreck as they were being taken across a river by canoe. The event became associated with the later name Matanzas, meaning “slaughters.”
simp_chinese: 瓜尼马尔是古巴北岸马坦萨斯湾的早期名称之一。避风的海湾接纳从内陆流下的河流。巴托洛梅·德拉斯卡萨斯记载，西班牙征服之前，一艘船的幸存者在此遇到原住民；他们乘独木舟渡河时遭到袭击。这一事件后来与地名马坦萨斯联系起来，其意为“屠杀”。

english:
Guanipa was Indigenous country in the plains of eastern Venezuela, crossed by the Tigre River and associated with Carib communities. Spanish attempts to establish settlements there encountered a region already connected to foreign commerce. In a letter of 1 May 1717, Cristóbal de Molina, commissioner of the Píritu missions, proposed founding two Spanish towns beside the river, then also called Lithe. He complained that foreign smugglers met Caribs and other Indigenous groups there and taught them to use firearms.

Mission settlement remained uncertain. In 1776 several Carib families asked the Observant Franciscans to gather them into a town, leading to the short-lived mission of San Máximo. Visiting in 1783, Luis de Chávez y Mendoza again recommended settlement, blaming the inaction of Cumaná's cattle owners. These episodes reveal a frontier where Indigenous decisions, unauthorised trading contacts, missionary plans and colonial demands overlapped. Proposals to populate Guanipa did not describe an empty landscape; they sought to reorganise people and exchanges already present.
simp_chinese:
瓜尼帕是委内瑞拉东部平原的原住民地域，蒂格雷河流经其间，与加勒比人社群相联系。西班牙尝试建立聚落时，这里已有对外贸易。1717年5月1日，皮里图传教区专员克里斯托瓦尔·德莫利纳致函总督，建议在又称Lithe的河岸建立两座西班牙城镇。他抱怨外国走私者在此同加勒比人及其他原住民交易，并教授火器使用。

传教聚落的发展仍不稳定。1776年，数个加勒比人家庭请求方济各会修士将其编入村镇，由此成立的圣马克西莫传教站存在不久。1783年，巡视官路易斯·德查韦斯·门多萨再次建议定居，并指责库马纳牧场主怠于行动。这些事件显示，原住民选择、未经许可的贸易、传教计划和殖民要求在此交叠。所谓拓殖，实际试图重组早已存在的人群与交换。

english:
Around Guantánamo, the upheavals in Saint-Domingue reshaped the mountains of eastern Cuba. From the 1790s, French plantation owners fleeing the revolution crossed to Spanish Cuba with enslaved Africans. They received land in the southeastern foothills and established coffee estates east and west of Guantánamo and Santiago. Their agricultural expansion rested on the forced labour of the people they enslaved.

The early nineteenth-century estates combined owners' houses, workers' quarters, terraced drying floors and processing buildings. Wet pulping required cisterns and aqueducts, while mountain roads and bridges connected the plantations with export outlets. Coffee production thus altered both the cultivated slopes and the routes through them. These estates formed part of a distinctive regional society shaped by migration from Saint-Domingue, French and Haitian practices, and African labour and cultural traditions.
simp_chinese:
圣多明各的动荡改变了关塔那摩周围的古巴东部山地。自十八世纪九十年代起，逃离革命的法国种植园主带着被奴役的非洲人渡海来到西属古巴。他们在东南部山麓获得土地，在关塔那摩和圣地亚哥东西两侧建立咖啡庄园。这场农业扩张依靠他们强迫奴隶付出的劳动。

十九世纪初的庄园包括主人住宅、劳工住处、阶梯状晾晒场与加工建筑。湿法脱皮需要蓄水池和引水渠，山路与桥梁则将庄园连接到出口地点。咖啡生产由此同时改变了耕作的山坡和穿越山地的道路。圣多明各移民、法国与海地的生产生活习惯，以及非洲人的劳动和文化传统，共同塑造了当地独特的区域社会。

english: Guantánamo Bay cuts deeply into the southeastern coast of Cuba, its broad inner harbour reached through a narrow entrance. Columbus entered the bay in 1494 and called it Puerto Grande. In 1741 a British expedition under Admiral Edward Vernon occupied the harbour during war with Spain and renamed it Cumberland Harbour. The force intended to move against Santiago de Cuba, but the expedition did not achieve its objective.
simp_chinese: 关塔那摩湾深入古巴东南岸，狭窄入口通向宽阔的内港。哥伦布于1494年进入海湾，称其为“大港”。1741年英西交战期间，爱德华·弗农海军上将率远征队占领港湾，将其改名为坎伯兰港。英军打算以此为基地进攻圣地亚哥，但远征未能达到目标。

english:
Guantao stood beside a long-established waterway linking the North China plain to the canal system. The river through the district was known as the Wei River during the Ming and Qing, preserving a transport corridor whose earlier names included Yongji Canal and Yu River. Its changing names accompanied successive uses and repairs of an enduring route.

In 1415 the completion of works on the Huitong Canal between Jining and Linqing restored the continuous north-south canal connection. Guantao's river formed part of this wider network, through which official grain shipments and other traffic reached the northern plain. The Guantao section revived during the Ming and Qing after an earlier decline. Its local history is consequently tied to the maintenance of a particular waterway, rather than simply to the prosperity of nearby Linqing.
simp_chinese:
馆陶傍依一条历史悠久的水道，将华北平原与运河体系连接起来。流经当地的河流在明清时期称卫河，更早曾有永济渠、御河等名称。河名的变化伴随着历代对同一交通走廊的利用和修整。

1415年，济宁至临清的会通河工程完成，南北运河重新贯通。馆陶河段属于这一更大的水路网络，官粮与其他船货由此通达北方平原。经历较早时期的衰落后，馆陶段又在明清复兴。因此，当地历史与一条具体河道的维持紧密相关，临清等运河城镇的商业也通过这条水路与馆陶发生联系。

english:
Guanyang was a county of northeastern Guangxi whose early modern institutions included both civil government and a military garrison. The Quanzhou gazetteer records that the county had previously lacked a city wall. A guard battalion established in 1395 marked a change: an earthen enclosure was built, and in 1450 the walls were faced with brick. Further repairs followed during the Zhengde reign.

The same account places the county offices in a compound built in the early Ming. After later destruction, magistrate Shan Fumu repaired it in 1669. A patrol office at Jining, eighty li west of the county seat, extended official supervision beyond the town. The gazetteer also lists Yongtai and Zhaoyi relay stations in the county, linking local government to communications through the surrounding country. These specific institutions give Guanyang a history of fortification, repair and administration. The walled seat, patrol station and relays formed different parts of the state's presence among the valleys and mountain routes.
simp_chinese:
灌阳是广西东北部的县，其近世制度同时包括民政机关与军事驻防。《全州志》记载，灌阳县原先没有城墙。1395年设守御千户所，随后筑土城；1450年又包砌砖墙，正德年间进一步重修。

同一记载称，县衙始建于明初，后来遭毁，1669年由知县单父牧修复。位于县治以西八十里的吉宁巡检司，将官府监督延伸到城外。志书还列有县内的永泰、昭义两驿，把地方治理同周围地域的通信联系起来。这些具体机构呈现了灌阳设防、修复与行政运作的历史：城中县治、巡检驻点和驿站，构成国家在河谷与山地通路间存在的不同部分。

english: Guanzhou stands by the mountain outlet of the Min River, where the Dujiangyan irrigation system directs water onto the Chengdu Plain. Begun in the third century BC, the works divide the river without a high dam: a stone embankment separates its channels, while a spillway and a cut through the hillside regulate the water reaching the plain. The system supports a network of canals across the fertile basin. Its effectiveness depended on repeated maintenance as the river deposited silt and altered its channels; a Qing gazetteer records repairs to the works in 1747.
simp_chinese: 灌州位于岷江出山之处，都江堰水利工程由此将江水引向成都平原。工程始建于公元前三世纪，不靠高坝截流，而以分水堤分开水道，再由溢洪道与开凿山体形成的通口调节进入平原的水量。渠网遍布肥沃的盆地，河水淤沙和水道变化使工程需要不断维护；清代地方志记载了乾隆十二年（1747）的一次修治。

english: Guaquili was an Indigenous town on a route through the Carolina interior towards Joara, near the Blue Ridge foothills. Hernando de Soto's expedition passed through the region in 1540. A generation later Juan Pardo's men followed a similar route, recording the town as Guaquiri. On Pardo's second journey in 1567, Guaquiri was among the towns that hosted his party as it travelled inland towards Joara.
simp_chinese: 瓜基利是一处原住民城镇，位于卡罗来纳内陆通往蓝岭山麓乔阿拉的道路上。1540年埃尔南多·德索托的远征队经过这一地区。约一代人之后，胡安·帕尔多的部下沿类似路线前行，将此镇记为瓜基里。1567年帕尔多第二次远征时，瓜基里是接待其队伍的城镇之一，他们继续向内陆的乔阿拉进发。

english:
Guaquire recalls the Guaiquires, one of the Indigenous peoples brought to the mission settlement later known as El Baúl. In 1744 Capuchin missionaries established San Miguel at the mouth of the Tinaco River, moving Guaiquires, Güires and Achaguas from the Apure and Orinoco country. The site on the Cojedes waterway served as a base for further missionary expeditions into the Llanos.

The settlement occupied a strategic point on a river network used by canoes travelling between the interior plains and the Orinoco. Missionaries sought to gather dispersed Indigenous communities there, while the people moved from their own territories had to adapt to the new settlement. In the early nineteenth century commerce along the Cojedes linked El Baúl with the river towns of Apure and the wider Orinoco basin.
simp_chinese:
瓜基雷让人想起瓜伊基雷斯人，他们是被带到后来称为埃尔包尔的传教聚落的原住民族之一。1744年，卡布遣会传教士在蒂纳科河口建立圣米格尔，将瓜伊基雷斯人、圭雷斯人和阿查瓜人从阿普雷与奥里诺科河地区迁来。科赫德斯水道上的这一地点成为进一步进入亚诺斯传教的基地。

聚落位于河流网络的战略位置，独木舟沿水道往来于内陆平原与奥里诺科河之间。传教士试图将分散的原住民社群集中到此，被迫离开各自领地的人们则需要适应新的聚落。十九世纪初，科赫德斯河的商业往来将埃尔包尔与阿普雷河城镇及更广阔的奥里诺科流域连接起来。

english: Guaraca was a Taíno cacique associated with Guayaney and the valley of the Guayanés River in eastern Puerto Rico. His people lived in a landscape of rivers descending toward the coast, where communities cultivated crops and maintained their own settlements. Early colonial records name Guaraca among the Indigenous leaders placed under Spanish encomienda, linking his name to the upheaval that followed the conquest of Borikén.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉卡是一位泰诺酋长，与波多黎各东部的瓜亚内伊及瓜亚内斯河谷有关。他的社群生活在河流流向海岸的地区，种植作物并维持自己的聚落。早期殖民记录将瓜拉卡列为被纳入西班牙委托监护制度的原住民首领之一，其名字因此与博里肯被征服后的巨大变动相连。

english: Guarapari lies on the coast of Espírito Santo, where rivers and inlets cut into the Atlantic shore. A village of Indigenous inhabitants developed here under Jesuit influence. In 1585 Father José de Anchieta built a chapel dedicated to Saint Anne and residences at the settlement. The village later became known as Guarapari and was raised to a town in 1679, amid the Portuguese occupation of the coast.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉帕里位于圣埃斯皮里图海岸，河流与海湾切入大西洋岸线。一座原住民村落在耶稣会影响下发展起来。1585年，若泽·迪安谢塔神父在此修建圣安娜小教堂及住宅。聚落后来称为瓜拉帕里，1679年在葡萄牙人占据这片海岸的过程中升格为镇。

english:
The fields of Guarapuava lie on the wooded plateau of southern Brazil, amid grasslands and forests of araucaria. Known to the Kaingang as Koran-bang-rê, this was part of their extensive territory in the Paraná uplands. Rivers cut through the plateau toward the Iguaçu and Paraná basins, while open fields provide a contrast to the surrounding stands of forest.

In 1810 a Portuguese expedition established the fort and mission settlement of Atalaia in the region. Kaingang leaders engaged with the newcomers through diplomacy as well as conflict, while settlers sought land for cattle and agriculture. The parish of Nossa Senhora de Belém de Guarapuava was founded in 1819, and during the following decades large estates spread over lands formerly held by Kaingang communities.
simp_chinese:
瓜拉普阿瓦原野位于巴西南部森林高原，草地与南洋杉林交错。凯因甘人称这里为科兰邦雷，它是他们在巴拉那高地广大领地的一部分。河流切穿高原，流向伊瓜苏和巴拉那流域，开阔原野与周围的林地形成对照。

1810年，葡萄牙远征队在此建立阿塔拉亚堡垒和传教聚落。凯因甘领袖通过外交和冲突与新来者周旋，定居者则寻求土地养牛和耕作。瓜拉普阿瓦的贝伦圣母堂区于1819年建立；此后数十年，大庄园在凯因甘社区原有的土地上扩张。

english: Guarasugwa takes its name from an Indigenous people of the upper Guaporé country. Also known as Pauserna, the Guarasugwe inhabited the forested region between the Guaporé, Paraguá and Pauserna rivers. Their language, Warázu, belongs to the Tupi-Guarani family. The rivers of this inland basin cross forests and seasonal wetlands, connecting a landscape inhabited by peoples with their own languages and territories long before the drawing of imperial borders.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉苏瓜以瓜波雷河上游的一支原住民族群命名。瓜拉苏圭人又称保塞尔纳人，居住在瓜波雷河、巴拉瓜河与保塞尔纳河之间的森林地区。他们的瓦拉苏语属于图皮—瓜拉尼语族。这片内陆流域的河流穿过森林和季节性湿地；在帝国边界划定很久以前，不同语言和领地的族群已生活于此。

english: Guarasugwe lies in the forested country of the upper Guaporé, a river known farther west as the Iténez. The Guarasugwe, or Pauserna, are an Indigenous people of this basin, with territory between the Guaporé, Paraguá and Pauserna rivers. Their language, Warázu, is part of the Tupi-Guarani family. Forest and river form a connected homeland, traversed by waterways that reach deep into the South American interior.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉苏圭位于瓜波雷河上游的森林地区；这条河在西边也称伊特内斯河。瓜拉苏圭人又称保塞尔纳人，是这一流域的原住民族群，领地包括瓜波雷河、巴拉瓜河和保塞尔纳河之间的土地。他们的瓦拉苏语属于图皮—瓜拉尼语族。森林与河流构成相连的家园，水道深入南美内陆。

english: The Guarasugwe forest lies in the upper Guaporé country, amid the waterways and woodland of the southwestern Amazon. Its name recalls the Guarasugwe people, also called Pauserna, whose territory includes the country between the Guaporé, Paraguá and Pauserna rivers. Their language, Warázu, belongs to the Tupi-Guarani family. Rivers thread through this forested interior, joining the lands on either side of the Guaporé.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉苏圭森林位于瓜波雷河上游地区，地处亚马孙西南部的水道与林地之间。森林的名字让人想起瓜拉苏圭人，他们又称保塞尔纳人，其领地包括瓜波雷河、巴拉瓜河与保塞尔纳河之间的地区。瓜拉苏圭人的瓦拉苏语属于图皮—瓜拉尼语族。河流穿过这片森林腹地，连接瓜波雷河两岸的土地。

english: Guaratinguetá lies in the Paraíba valley between the Serra do Mar and the Mantiqueira mountains. A chapel dedicated to Saint Anthony was built here in 1630, and the settlement became a town in 1651. In 1717 fishermen found an image of Our Lady of the Conception in the Paraíba River; devotion to the image later gave rise to the neighbouring settlement of Aparecida.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉廷格塔位于海岸山脉与曼蒂凯拉山脉之间的帕拉伊巴河谷。1630年，这里修建了供奉圣安东尼奥的小教堂，聚落于1651年成为镇。1717年，渔民在帕拉伊巴河中发现一尊无染原罪圣母像；对圣像的信仰后来促成了邻近阿帕雷西达聚落的形成。

english: The waters around Guaraú Island lie off the southern coast of São Paulo, near Peruíbe. The small island rises from the Atlantic a short distance from the shore, opposite the mouth of the Guaraú River. Behind the beaches the forested Serra do Mar meets the coastal plain. Rocky islands, river mouths and sheltered stretches of shore give this part of the coast a varied outline.
simp_chinese: 瓜劳岛周围水域位于圣保罗南岸、佩鲁伊比附近。这座小岛在离岸不远的大西洋中升起，与瓜劳河口相对。海滩后方，森林覆盖的濒海山脉与沿海平原相接。岩岛、河口和较受遮蔽的海岸，共同构成这一带多变的岸线。

english: The Guarayo are a Guaraní-speaking people of the eastern Bolivian lowlands. Their ancestors came from the Itatín region near the confluence of the Apa and Paraguay rivers, moving westward into a country of forests and savannas. Franciscan missions later sought to gather Guarayo communities into settlements; in the nineteenth century these included Ascensión, Urubichá, Yaguarú and Yotaú. Their language preserves a connection with other peoples of the Tupí-Guaraní family.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉约人是玻利维亚东部低地使用瓜拉尼语的民族。他们的祖先来自阿帕河与巴拉圭河交汇附近的伊塔廷地区，向西迁入森林和稀树草原。方济各会传教士后来试图将瓜拉约社群集中到聚落之中；十九世纪的传教聚落包括阿森西翁、乌鲁比查、亚瓜鲁和约陶。瓜拉约语保留了与其他图皮—瓜拉尼语族民族的联系。

english: Guarda rises high above the lands of Beira Alta, near the Serra da Estrela and the frontier with Castile. Sancho I founded the city in 1199 in a position chosen for its defensibility and transferred the bishopric from Idanha. Its walls and castle guarded a town that also became a religious center. The cathedral begun in the reign of John I was enlarged over the following century. Guarda's Jewish quarter was already important in the thirteenth century, and the community received newcomers expelled from Spain in 1492. Its merchants and households contributed to the life of a border city whose fortunes were shaped by both defense and exchange.
simp_chinese: 瓜达高踞上贝拉地区，靠近埃什特雷拉山和卡斯蒂利亚边境。桑乔一世于1199年选择这处易守之地创建城市，并将主教座从伊达尼亚迁来。城墙和城堡守护着这座同时成为宗教中心的城镇。若昂一世时期开建的主教座堂在此后一百多年间得到扩建。瓜达的犹太街区早在十三世纪便颇具重要性，1492年又接纳了被逐出西班牙的犹太人。这里的商人和家庭参与了边境城市的生活，防御与交换共同影响着城市的命运。

english: The Guardafui Channel lies between the tip of the Horn of Africa and Socotra, joining the Gulf of Aden to the Indian Ocean. Ships rounding the cape crossed waters shaped by seasonal winds and strong currents. The passage formed part of routes between the Red Sea, Arabia, eastern Africa and India, while the arid Somali headlands and the high land of Socotra marked its opposite sides.
simp_chinese: 瓜达富伊海峡位于非洲之角尖端与索科特拉岛之间，连接亚丁湾和印度洋。绕过海角的船只穿越受季节风及强流影响的水域。这条通道是连接红海、阿拉伯、东非和印度航路的一部分，干旱的索马里岬地与索科特拉高地分列两侧。

english: Guárico lies in the central Venezuelan Llanos, where the Guárico River winds across a plain of savannas and seasonal wetlands. Near its banks, Capuchin missionaries gathered Indigenous people from the Orinoco and the Llanos into settlements that included Guaiquerí, Mapoyo, Tamanaco and Otomaco families. In 1724 a cross was raised at the site of Calabozo, marking the foundation of a new town. During the second half of the eighteenth century Calabozo became a centre of the plains' livestock economy, where cattle, mules and horses could be gathered and traded.
simp_chinese: 瓜里科位于委内瑞拉亚诺斯中部，瓜里科河蜿蜒流过稀树草原和季节性湿地。嘉布遣会传教士在河岸附近建立聚落，将来自奥里诺科河与亚诺斯的原住民集中起来，其中包括瓜伊克里、马波约、塔马纳科和奥托马科家庭。1724年，人们在卡拉沃索城址竖起十字架，标志着新城的建立。十八世纪后半叶，卡拉沃索成为平原畜牧经济的中心，牛、骡和马在此汇集交易。

english: Guarinoes lies in the northern Tolima country near the Magdalena valley, at the place later called Mariquita. Indigenous communities inhabited the region before Spanish prospectors sought its mineral wealth. In 1551 Francisco Núñez Pedroso founded San Sebastián de Mariquita, giving colonial authorities a centre from which to oversee nearby deposits of gold and silver. Mines such as La Parroquia and Cajongora helped make the settlement important in the colonial interior.
simp_chinese: 瓜里诺斯位于马格达莱纳河谷附近的托利马北部，即后来称为马里基塔的地方。西班牙探矿者寻找矿藏以前，原住民社群已居住于此。1551年，弗朗西斯科·努涅斯·佩德罗索建立圣塞瓦斯蒂安－德马里基塔，使殖民当局有了一处管理附近金银矿的中心。拉帕罗基亚、卡洪戈拉等矿山帮助聚落成为殖民内陆的重要地点。

english: Guarisamey lies in the deep western valleys of the Sierra Madre Occidental, within a region rich in silver and gold. Its mines drew settlers into a difficult mountain landscape during the eighteenth century. In 1784 José Fernández and Cayetano Flores discovered the Tecolotita mine near the Piaxtla River, renewing the fortunes of Guarisamey. The mining district also drew the investment of Juan José Zambrano, one of the prominent entrepreneurs of late colonial Durango.
simp_chinese: 瓜里萨梅位于西马德雷山脉西部深谷，周围地区富含金银。十八世纪，矿山吸引定居者进入这片交通艰难的山区。1784年，何塞·费尔南德斯和卡耶塔诺·弗洛雷斯在皮亚斯特拉河附近发现特科洛蒂塔矿，使瓜里萨梅再度兴盛。殖民时代晚期杜兰戈的著名企业家胡安·何塞·桑布拉诺也投资了这一矿区。

english: Guaritico lies on the Apure River in the Venezuelan Llanos, where the settlement later called Bruzual grew beside the waterway. The Apure crosses a wide plain of savanna and seasonal wetlands before joining the Orinoco. Boats could follow the river through a country where the rainy season flooded extensive tracts and the dry season exposed the grasslands used for cattle grazing.
simp_chinese: 瓜里蒂科位于委内瑞拉亚诺斯的阿普雷河畔，后来称作布鲁苏阿尔的聚落沿水道发展。阿普雷河穿过宽阔的稀树草原和季节性湿地，最终注入奥里诺科河。船只可沿河穿行：雨季大片土地被淹没，旱季则露出供牛群放牧的草地。

english: Guarungube was an Indigenous town among the islands at the southern end of Florida. Hernando de Escalante Fontaneda, who lived for years among the peoples of the peninsula after a shipwreck, named it in his sixteenth-century account of the coast. He placed Guarungube and Cuchiyaga among the towns of the islands the Spanish called the Martyrs. The waters and channels of the Keys connected these communities with the mainland and the neighbouring peoples of southern Florida.
simp_chinese: 瓜伦古贝是佛罗里达南端群岛中的一座原住民城镇。埃尔南多·德·埃斯卡兰特·丰塔内达遭遇船难后，在半岛原住民中生活多年；他在十六世纪的海岸记述中提到了这座城镇。他将瓜伦古贝和库奇亚加列为西班牙人称作“殉道者群岛”的岛上城镇。佛罗里达礁岛的水域与航道把这些社群同大陆及南佛罗里达的邻族连接起来。

english: Guarzo lies in the uplands of eastern Antioquia, in country formerly inhabited by Tahamí and Quirama peoples. A settlement known as El Guarzo grew within the jurisdiction of Rionegro, in the valley watered by the Guarzo stream and the Pantanillo River. From 1786 it attracted settlers of varied origins, including free people of African descent. Recognised as a rural district in 1790, it gained a parish in 1814 under the name El Retiro.
simp_chinese: 瓜尔索位于安蒂奥基亚东部高地，原为塔哈米和基拉马人的居地。名为瓜尔索的聚落在里奥内格罗辖区内发展起来，所在谷地有瓜尔索溪和潘塔尼约河流过。自1786年起，不同出身的居民在此定居，其中包括获得自由的非洲裔居民。1790年这里被承认为乡区，1814年以埃尔雷蒂罗之名设立堂区。

english:
Guastalla stands near the River Po, where it served in the Middle Ages as a toll point for goods travelling along the waterway. It was also the centre of a rich agricultural estate. Its name is recorded as early as 864. The Torelli family ruled the town from 1406 until 1539, when it passed to the Gonzaga.

Under the Gonzaga, Guastalla became the seat of a small state and a court that attracted artists and writers, among them Guercino and Torquato Tasso. It was a duchy from 1621 to 1748. The Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle brought Guastalla into the Duchy of Parma and Piacenza, adding the Po-side town to the territories of a larger neighbouring state. It remained with Parma through the Napoleonic period and the subsequent restoration.
simp_chinese:
瓜斯塔拉位于波河附近，中世纪时在此河道上往来的货物须在此缴纳通行税。它也是一处富庶农业庄园的中心。其名称早在864年已有记载。托雷利家族从1406年统治此城，直到1539年瓜斯塔拉转入贡扎加家族手中。

贡扎加家族统治下，瓜斯塔拉成为一个小国的驻地，其宫廷吸引了圭尔奇诺和托尔夸托·塔索等艺术家与作家。1621年至1748年间，瓜斯塔拉为公国。亚琛条约使它并入帕尔马和皮亚琴察公国，这座波河畔的城镇由此成为邻近较大国家领土的一部分，并在拿破仑时代及随后的复辟时期继续隶属帕尔马。

english: Guatacuba lies in the northeastern interior of Goiás, in the mining country of the Brazilian interior far from the coast, where the cerrado grasslands and gallery forest made travel to the coast slow. By the middle of the eighteenth century the settlement was known as São Teodoro, and its inhabitants worked the area's gold deposits.
simp_chinese: 瓜塔库巴位于戈亚斯东北部内陆，属于远离海岸的巴西矿区。十八世纪中叶，当地聚落称为圣特奥多罗，居民开采这一带的金矿。周围的塞拉多草原与沿河林地使矿区与海岸之间的往来十分缓慢。

english: The Guató are an Indigenous people of the Pantanal, the vast floodplain of the upper Paraguay basin. Known for their skill with canoes, they inhabited a country of rivers, lakes and seasonally flooded land. An eighteenth-century account describes Guató cultivation of maize, squash, potatoes and cotton on raised ground made with shells and sand, above the reach of floodwater.
simp_chinese: 瓜托人是巴拉圭河上游流域广大洪泛平原潘塔纳尔的原住民族。他们以善用独木舟闻名，居住在河流、湖泊和季节性淹水的土地之间。一份十八世纪记载称，瓜托人在用贝壳和沙土筑高、避开洪水的土地上种植玉米、南瓜、薯类和棉花。

english: The Guaviare is formed by the meeting of the Ariari and Guayabero rivers east of the Colombian Andes. It flows across the northern South American lowlands to join the Orinoco near the Atabapo. The upper basin lies where the eastern plains meet Amazonian forests and the isolated uplands of the Sierra de la Macarena. River channels connect these different landscapes over distances far greater than the settlements along their banks.
simp_chinese: 瓜维亚雷河由哥伦比亚安第斯山东侧的阿里亚里河和瓜亚韦罗河汇合而成，流经南美洲北部低地，在阿塔瓦波附近注入奥里诺科河。上游流域地处东部平原与亚马孙森林的交界，也靠近孤立的马卡雷纳山地。河道跨越广阔距离，将这些不同景观与沿岸聚落联系起来。

english: The Guaxaban were an Indigenous people of the northern Guanajuato frontier, related to Guachichil communities and allied with neighboring groups. Franciscan missionary Bernardo Cossin founded a church called San Francisco at Carrizalejo and gathered Guaxaban people around it. The spread of Spanish ranches and missions did not end resistance in the region: in 1589 Guaxaban fighters attacked an estate near San Felipe, taking livestock. Their history belongs to the long struggle and negotiation over the Chichimeca frontier.
simp_chinese: 瓜沙班人是瓜纳华托北部边疆的原住民，与瓜奇奇尔社群有联系，也同邻近群体结盟。方济各会传教士贝尔纳多·科辛在卡里萨莱霍建立圣弗朗西斯科教堂，将瓜沙班人聚集于附近。西班牙牧场和传教站扩张并未终止当地抵抗：1589年，瓜沙班战士袭击圣费利佩附近的一处庄园，带走牲畜。他们的历史属于奇奇梅卡边疆长期斗争与谈判的一部分。

sources.title: Entre cruces y apareados  análisis del sistema ritual de una comunidad peregrina en la zona media de San Luis Potosí.pdf

english: The Guaxenicos inhabited the country north of León, in the lowlands toward the Gulf of Fonseca. The sixteenth-century chronicler Gonzalo Fernández de Oviedo described communities bearing this name along the route beyond Olocotón toward Palangagalpa. Their settlements lay within a landscape of rivers and plains on the Pacific side of Nicaragua, where several indigenous peoples encountered the advancing Spanish colonial settlements.
simp_chinese: 瓜谢尼科斯人居住在莱昂以北、通向丰塞卡湾的低地。十六世纪编年者贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·奥维耶多记载，从奥洛科通向帕兰加加尔帕前进的路上，有多个以此名称呼的社区。他们的聚落位于尼加拉瓜太平洋一侧的河流与平原之间，这里的多个原住民族遭遇了不断推进的西班牙殖民聚落。

english: Guaxule lies in the high valleys of the southern Appalachians, where the Great Smoky Mountains fall toward the Pigeon River and Cosby Creek on the Tennessee and North Carolina line. Steep ridges left only narrow bottomlands for corn, beans and squash, so Cherokee families built along creeks and river terraces and hunted deer, bear and turkey in the coves above. Trails crossed the ridges toward the Tuckasegee and the French Broad, linking mountain towns with one another and with distant hunting grounds. In 1761 British forces under James Grant marched through the Cherokee country and burned many of its towns and fields, ending the Anglo-Cherokee War.
simp_chinese: 瓜苏莱位于南阿巴拉契亚山地的高谷中，大烟山在这里向田纳西与北卡罗来纳交界处的松鸡河和科斯比溪一带降落。陡峭山脊只留下狭窄的谷底，居民在溪边和河阶上种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，并在上方的山坳里猎捕鹿、熊和火鸡。山间小路翻越山脊，通向图卡西吉河和法国宽河，把各个山地村镇与远处的猎场连接起来。1761年，詹姆斯·格兰特率领的英军穿过切罗基地区，焚毁了大批村镇和田地，英切战争由此结束。

english: The Guayabitos Coast faces the Pacific along the shores of Nayarit. Here the bay of Jaltemba curves between headlands, sheltering a sandy beach from the open sea. Warm waters meet the coast below the wooded hills of western Mexico. The bay and its nearby islands form part of a varied shoreline of coves and rocky points, where the coastal plain is framed by rising land inland.
simp_chinese: 瓜亚比托斯海岸位于纳亚里特的太平洋沿岸。哈尔滕巴湾在两处海角之间弯曲，为沙滩提供遮蔽，隔开外海的波浪。温暖海水拍打着墨西哥西部林丘下的海岸。海湾及附近岛屿构成多变岸线的一部分，海湾与岩岬交错，内陆山地环绕沿海平原。

english: The Guayacundo people occupied the highlands of northern Peru, where settled communities practised agriculture and crafts and maintained contacts with both the coast and the forested lands to the east. Their territory included Caxas, an Inca centre established after the conquest of the region by Túpac Yupanqui. From there the Inca state administered part of its northern dominions; the Guayacundos themselves served the empire in positions of responsibility.
simp_chinese: 瓜亚昆多人居住在秘鲁北部高地，定居村落从事农业和手工业，并同海岸及东面的森林地带保持联系。其领地包括卡哈斯：图帕克·尤潘基征服这一地区后，印加人在此建立了中心。印加国家从这里管理北方领地的一部分，而瓜亚昆多人也为帝国效力，担任要职。

english: Guayana lies in the river country of northern South America, where the Essequibo and its tributaries flow through forests toward the Atlantic. Indigenous peoples inhabited these waterways before Europeans established trading posts. Around 1616 the Dutch founded a settlement on the Essequibo, and Fort Kyk-over-al stood near the meeting of the Cuyuni, Mazaruni and Essequibo. Relations with Indigenous communities were central to the survival and commerce of the river colony.
simp_chinese: 圭亚那位于南美洲北部的河流地区，埃塞奎博河及其支流穿过森林，流向大西洋。欧洲人建立贸易站之前，原住民族群已居住在这些水道沿岸。约1616年，荷兰人在埃塞奎博河建立聚落，凯克奥弗阿尔堡坐落在库尤尼河、马扎鲁尼河与埃塞奎博河交会附近。与原住民社群的关系对河流殖民地的生存和贸易至关重要。

english: The Guiana coast borders a low, wet plain between the Orinoco and the rivers of Guyana. The Waini reaches the Atlantic through swamp forest at the eastern edge of the Orinoco delta. Offshore currents carry fine sediment northwest along the coast, creating migrating mudbanks; mangroves can take root in the sheltered mud. Tides and river channels continually reshape the meeting of land and sea.
simp_chinese: 圭亚那海岸邻接奥里诺科河与圭亚那诸河之间低湿的平原。瓦伊尼河穿过奥里诺科三角洲东缘的沼泽林，流入大西洋。近海洋流将细泥沙沿岸向西北输送，形成移动的泥滩；红树林能够在受保护的泥地上扎根。潮汐和河道不断改变海陆交接的形态。

english: The Guayana Jungle spreads across the ancient Guiana Shield in the interior of Suriname. Dense tropical forest covers its weathered hills, and rivers descend northward toward the Atlantic from the upland watershed. Rapids interrupt many of their courses. This great forest forms part of a much wider belt of woodland extending across the Guianas, where waterways cut through old rock and connect the interior with the coast.
simp_chinese: 圭亚那丛林遍布苏里南内陆古老的圭亚那地盾。茂密热带森林覆盖风化丘陵，河流从高地分水岭向北流向大西洋，许多河道途中有急流。这里的森林属于横跨圭亚那地区的广阔林带，水道切穿古老岩层，连接内陆与海岸。

english:
Guayangareo was the name of a valley in the highlands of Michoacán, where the Spanish city of Valladolid was founded near an Indigenous Pirinda settlement. Built on a hill in a regular plan, the city became known for its churches and buildings of pink stone. It eventually rivalled Pátzcuaro as the political and religious centre of the province.

In 1541 Viceroy Antonio de Mendoza ordered the establishment of a Spanish city in the valley. During the following decades it acquired the name Valladolid, and in 1580 the civil authorities and episcopal seat were transferred there from Pátzcuaro. Religious orders established convents, while Indigenous communities were gathered outside the centre. The cathedral, begun in 1660 and consecrated in 1705, became the focus of an increasingly imposing city. Valladolid also became a centre of ideas associated with the independence movement. José María Morelos was born there, and Miguel Hidalgo studied and taught at the College of San Nicolás. In 1828 the city was renamed Morelia in honour of Morelos, linking its colonial streets with the memory of the struggle for independence.
simp_chinese:
瓜扬加雷奥是米却肯高地一处谷地的名称，西班牙城市巴利亚多利德建立在附近的皮林达人聚落旁。城市依山丘按规则布局，以教堂和粉红色石材建筑闻名，后来与帕茨夸罗争夺全省政治和宗教中心的地位。

1541年，总督安东尼奥·德·门多萨下令在谷地建立西班牙人城市。此后数十年间，它获得巴利亚多利德之名；1580年，民政当局和主教座堂从帕茨夸罗迁来。各修会建立修道院，原住民社群则被集中在市中心之外。大教堂于1660年动工、1705年祝圣，成为日益壮丽的城市的核心。巴利亚多利德也是与独立运动相关的思想中心。何塞·玛丽亚·莫雷洛斯出生于此，米格尔·伊达尔戈曾在圣尼古拉斯学院学习和任教。1828年，城市为纪念莫雷洛斯改名莫雷利亚，使殖民时期的街道与独立斗争的记忆相连。

english:
Guayaquil stands on the Guayas River, where the waterways of the coastal lowlands come together before reaching the Pacific. Its position made it both a port and a shipbuilding centre, drawing on the timber of the surrounding country and the produce carried downriver. Cacao grown in the Guayas basin became the foundation of a flourishing trade, binding the city to ports throughout the Spanish Pacific.

The Spanish established Guayaquil during the 1530s. Colonial shipyards built vessels ranging from small craft to ships for the South Sea fleet, while merchants shipped the products of the coast overseas. Prosperity also brought danger: in 1687 English and French buccaneers attacked and plundered the town, taking captives for ransom. The city was later moved to a more defensible site downstream. Its shipyards continued to draw workers and materials from a wide hinterland, and the port remained a principal point of contact between the coast and the larger Pacific world. During the late eighteenth century, the relaxation of restrictions on trade helped cacao exports rise sharply, enriching planters and merchants in the river basin.

On 9 October 1820, civilians and soldiers overthrew the Spanish authorities with little bloodshed and proclaimed independence. José Joaquín de Olmedo became a leading figure in the new government. In 1822 Simón Bolívar and José de San Martín met at Guayaquil as the struggle for independence continued farther south.
simp_chinese:
瓜亚基尔坐落在瓜亚斯河畔，海岸低地的河流在此汇聚，随后流向太平洋。优越的位置使它成为港口和造船中心：周围林地提供木材，河流运来内陆物产。瓜亚斯流域种植的可可成为繁荣贸易的基础，将城市与西班牙统治下太平洋沿岸的港口联系起来。

西班牙人于1530年代建立瓜亚基尔。殖民时期的船坞建造从小船到南海舰队舰船的各类船只，商人则把海岸物产运往海外。繁荣也招来危险：1687年英法海盗袭击并洗劫城镇，掳走居民索取赎金。城市后来迁往下游更易防守的地点。船坞继续从广阔的腹地吸引劳工和获取材料，港口也始终是海岸与更广大太平洋世界的重要接点。十八世纪后期，贸易限制放宽推动可可出口大幅增长，河流流域的种植园主和商人因而获利。

1820年10月9日，平民与士兵几乎不流血便推翻西班牙当局，宣布独立。何塞·华金·德·奥尔梅多成为新政府的重要人物。1822年，西蒙·玻利瓦尔与何塞·德·圣马丁在瓜亚基尔会面，而南方的独立战争仍在继续。

english:
The Guaycura inhabited the southern Baja California peninsula, between the country near Loreto and the region of Todos Santos. Their homeland included dry mountains, coastal waters and scattered sources of fresh water. Hunting, fishing and gathering supported communities moving through a landscape where rainfall was uncertain and cultivable land limited.

Spanish expeditions visited the peninsula in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, but permanent mission settlement began at Loreto in 1697. Jesuit missions subsequently spread through Guaycura country, seeking to gather people into settlements and convert them to Christianity. Contact brought disease and profound population loss, while new settlements changed access to the places and resources on which Indigenous communities had depended. The missions depended heavily on supplies brought across the gulf from the mainland.
simp_chinese:
瓜伊库拉人居住在下加利福尼亚半岛南部，地域从洛雷托附近延伸至托多斯桑托斯一带。故土包括干燥山地、沿海水域和零散淡水源。降雨不定、可耕地有限，狩猎、捕鱼和采集供养着在各处移动的社区。

西班牙远征队曾于十六、十七世纪访问半岛，但永久传教聚落直到1697年才在洛雷托建立。耶稣会传教区随后扩展到瓜伊库拉地区，试图集中居民并使其改信基督教。接触带来疾病和严重人口损失，新聚落也改变了原住民社区获取赖以生活的土地与资源的方式。 传教区在很大程度上依靠从海湾对岸大陆运来的补给。

english: Guaygata was a region of Indigenous Jamaica named in accounts of Columbus’s fourth voyage. It included the village of Aguacadiba, where a cacique and local inhabitants agreed to provide food to the stranded Spanish crews. Cassava bread, game and fish were exchanged for small goods. The episode reveals a network of villages and leaders in Jamaica before Spanish colonization began, rooted in both cultivation and the resources of the sea.
simp_chinese: 瓜伊加塔是牙买加的一个原住民地区，哥伦布第四次航行的记载中提到了它。这里包括阿瓜卡迪瓦村，当地酋长与居民同意向受困的西班牙船员提供食物，以木薯饼、猎物和鱼换取小商品。这一事件展现了西班牙殖民开始之前牙买加的村落与首领网络，其生活依赖耕作和海洋资源。

english:
Guaynabo lies near the northern coast of Puerto Rico, among the hills and lowlands west of San Juan Bay. Here stood Caparra, the first permanent Spanish settlement on the island and the seat of its early colonial government. Its location linked the harbor with routes toward the interior and the gold-bearing country sought by the conquerors.

Juan Ponce de León founded Caparra in 1508. The settlement included his fortified house and a foundry, but its position inland from the harbor proved inconvenient. In the early 1520s the Spanish moved the town to the island at the entrance to San Juan Bay, where the port and city could develop together. Caparra was abandoned, leaving the foundations of the first colonial center behind.
simp_chinese:
瓜伊纳沃位于波多黎各北岸附近，坐落在圣胡安湾以西的丘陵与低地之间。这里曾有卡帕拉，岛上最早的永久西班牙聚落和早期殖民政府所在地。它的位置将港口与通往内陆、征服者寻求黄金的地区的道路连接起来。

胡安·庞塞·德莱昂于1508年建立卡帕拉。聚落内有他的坚固住宅与冶炼所，但远离港口的位置并不便利。1520年代初，西班牙人将城镇迁往圣胡安湾入口处的岛屿，使港口与城市共同发展。卡帕拉被放弃，留下了最初殖民中心的地基。

english: Guaynia is the name traditionally given to the domain of the Taíno chief Agüeybaná in southwestern Puerto Rico. Several Indigenous settlements in the Guánica region belonged to his sphere of authority. In 1508 Juan Ponce de León met Agüeybaná and established a relationship of friendship and kinship known as guaitiao. The encounter preceded a longer process of Spanish conquest that transformed the island and the lives of its inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 瓜伊尼亚是传统上给予波多黎各西南部泰诺首领阿圭瓦纳领地的名称。瓜尼卡地区的若干原住民聚落属于他的权力范围。1508年，胡安·庞塞·德莱昂与阿圭瓦纳会面，建立了称为瓜伊蒂亚奥的友谊与亲属关系。此后，持续多年的西班牙征服改变了这座岛屿及其居民的生活。

english:
The Guayupe inhabited the eastern Andean foothills and the plains around the Ariari River. They spoke an Arawak language and cultivated yuca, from which they made cassava bread. Their settlements could be protected by wooden palisades, thorn barriers and concealed pits; houses stood around a central open space. Rivers supplied fish and served as routes for canoes.

Spanish expeditions encountered determined resistance in the sixteenth century. Alonso de Herrera’s force suffered losses in 1534, and Georg Hohermuth von Speyer’s expedition fought its way through Guayupe country in the following years. One fortified village impressed the Europeans enough to be compared with the fortress of Salses. These encounters reveal the strength of local defences as outsiders attempted to cross the eastern plains.
simp_chinese:
瓜尤佩人居住在安第斯山东麓及阿里亚里河周围平原，使用阿拉瓦克语，种植木薯并制作木薯饼。村庄周围可以设置木栅、荆棘障碍和隐蔽陷坑，房屋则围绕中央空地排列。河流提供鱼类，也是独木舟的通路。

十六世纪，西班牙远征队遭遇了坚决抵抗。1534年，阿隆索·德埃雷拉的队伍受到损失；此后数年，格奥尔格·霍赫穆特·冯施派尔的远征在战斗中穿过瓜尤佩地区。一座设防村庄使欧洲人印象深刻，被他们比作萨尔塞斯要塞。外来者试图穿越东部平原时，地方防御的力量在这些遭遇中充分显现。

english:
Guazacapán developed as a colonial administrative and parish centre on Guatemala's Pacific side. Its earlier history belonged to the Xinca country confronted by Spanish campaigns in the 1520s. Under Spanish rule it became the seat of a corregimiento; during the eighteenth century that jurisdiction was incorporated into the larger administration of Escuintla.

A petition of 1589 records the practical difficulties of building the parish church. Indigenous craftsmen and labourers needed wages and food, but communal funds were insufficient; the parish priest's representative asked that some local fines be directed towards the work. The document reveals the church taking shape through Indigenous labour and negotiations over local resources. After independence, the territorial arrangements of 1825 placed Guazacapán in District Two alongside neighbouring communities including Chiquimulilla and Taxisco.
simp_chinese:
瓜萨卡潘在危地马拉太平洋一侧发展为殖民行政与教区中心。此前这里属于辛卡人的地区，十六世纪二十年代遭遇西班牙军队的征服。西班牙统治下，瓜萨卡潘成为地方行政区的治所；十八世纪，这一辖区并入以埃斯昆特拉为中心的较大行政区。

1589年的一份请愿书记录了修建教堂的实际困难。原住民工匠与劳工需要工资和食物，社区资金却不足，教区神父的代理人因此请求将部分地方罚金用于工程。这份文书呈现了教堂建设背后的原住民劳动，以及围绕地方财力进行的协商。独立以后，1825年的区划安排将瓜萨卡潘与邻近的奇基穆利亚、塔克西斯科等地一同划入第二区。

english: The Guazapayogliglas were one of the Indigenous groups named in Spanish accounts of the desert north of Nueva Vizcaya. Colonial writers associated them with the Toboso and Chisos peoples, whose country extended across the Bolsón de Mapimí and toward the Rio Grande. In the seventeenth century Toboso groups resisted Spanish expansion and raided settlements around the desert basin. The Guazapayogliglas were still named among these communities in the records of 1693, alongside the Chichitames and Osatayogliglas.
simp_chinese: 瓜萨帕约格利格拉斯人是西班牙记载中生活在新比斯开北方沙漠的原住民群体之一。殖民文献将他们与托博索和奇索斯人联系起来，后者的活动地区包括马皮米盆地并延伸至格兰德河方向。十七世纪，托博索群体抵抗西班牙扩张，袭击沙漠盆地周围的聚落。1693年的记录仍将瓜萨帕约格利格拉斯人与奇奇塔梅斯、奥萨塔约格利格拉斯等群体并列。

english:
Guazhou is an oasis district in the western Hexi Corridor, between the desert routes leading to Dunhuang and the eastern garrisons. Irrigation from the Shule River sustained cultivation beside the caravan road. South of the oasis, Buddhist caves were cut into the cliffs of the Yulin River gorge. Their paintings and sculptures grew over many centuries, from the Tang through the Western Xia and Yuan, reflecting the different peoples and religious traditions that met along the corridor.

Mongol rule brought Guazhou into the Yuan realm, but in 1292 people from Guazhou and Shazhou were moved east to the Ganzhou area. Under the Ming, the forts and pastures west of Jiayuguan were contested by several powers. As the frontier shifted and traffic changed, the older walled settlements of the oasis declined. The Yulin caves continued to serve as places of worship, and their paintings preserve a record of the region's Buddhist patrons and artistic connections.
simp_chinese:
瓜州是河西走廊西部的绿洲地区，位于通往敦煌的沙漠道路与东边卫所之间。疏勒河的灌溉维持了商旅道路旁的耕地。绿洲以南，榆林河峡谷的崖壁上开凿了佛教石窟。窟内壁画与塑像经唐、西夏、元等朝代不断营建，体现了在走廊相遇的不同民族和宗教传统。

瓜州在蒙古统治下进入元朝疆域，但1292年瓜、沙二州居民被迁往甘州一带。明代，嘉峪关以西的城堡与牧地成为多方争夺之处。边界和交通的变化使绿洲旧城逐渐衰落；榆林窟仍是礼佛之所，其壁画保存了地方佛教供养者与艺术交流的痕迹。

english: Guazoco was a Native town in the interior of Florida, near the upper reaches of the Withlacoochee River. Hernando de Soto's expedition passed through its country in 1539 after landing on the Gulf coast. Here the Spaniards encountered fields of maize, a welcome source of provisions for the army as it pressed northward. Beyond Guazoco lay other settlements, including Luca and Vicela, on the expedition's route toward the lands of the Apalachee.
simp_chinese: 瓜佐科是佛罗里达内陆的一处原住民村镇，靠近威斯拉科奇河上游。1539年，埃尔南多·德索托的远征队在墨西哥湾沿岸登陆后，经过这一地区。西班牙人在此发现玉米田，为向北行进的队伍提供了急需的粮食。瓜佐科以北还有卢卡和维塞拉等聚落，远征队经此继续前往阿巴拉契人的土地。

english:
Guba lay on the frontier between the Funj kingdom of Sennar and the western approaches of Ethiopia. Local traditions associate its ruling line with Sheikh Hammad and a settlement on Dungul hill towards the Beles River. The dynasty's emergence is generally placed in the later eighteenth century, amid the political changes that followed the Hamaj takeover of Sennar in 1762. Its authority extended over Gumuz communities and depended on relationships across this frontier.

The Turco-Egyptian conquest of Sudan in 1821 introduced another layer of power. Guba paid tribute to the new government but was treated as subordinate to the distant chief of Ghule, rather than receiving the standing accorded to some other frontier rulers. Distance and limited outside administration left room for its chiefs to strengthen their local position. Guba's location also made it a trading centre, where commercial connections and claims to tribute joined the politics of a borderland between larger states.
simp_chinese:
古巴位于丰吉森纳尔王国与埃塞俄比亚西部之间的边地。地方传统将统治家系与谢赫·哈马德相联系，并把其早期定居点置于通往贝莱斯河的敦古尔山。这个王朝的形成通常被放在十八世纪后期，与1762年哈马杰掌握森纳尔政权之后的政治变化有关。它统治古穆兹社群，并依靠跨越边地的关系维持权力。

1821年，奥斯曼埃及军队征服苏丹，又带来一层外部权力。古巴向新政府纳贡，却被置于远方古勒首领之下，没有获得部分其他边地统治者那样的地位。距离遥远、外部行政薄弱，使当地首领仍有巩固自身权力的空间。古巴同时是贸易中心，商业联系与贡赋要求在这里交织，构成较大国家之间边疆政治的一部分。

english: Gubakha arose in 1755 beside an iron-ore deposit on Krestovaya Mountain, at the meeting of the Gubashka and Kosva rivers. The village served as a landing for barges that carried ore from the upper Kosva toward the Kama. Coal was found on Krestovaya Mountain in 1825, and the first mining adit was opened there. At first output remained small, with coal floated down the Kosva to the ironworks at Chermoz.
simp_chinese: 古巴哈于1755年在克列斯托瓦亚山的铁矿附近兴起，位于古巴什卡河与科斯瓦河交汇处。村庄设有码头，驳船从科斯瓦河上游将铁矿石运向卡马河。1825年，人们在克列斯托瓦亚山发现煤，并开掘了第一条采矿平硐。最初产量不大，煤沿科斯瓦河漂运至切尔莫兹的冶金厂。

english: Gubbi Gubbi, or Kabi Kabi, country lies in southeastern Queensland, from the coastal rivers toward the forested ranges inland. The bunya pine was known as bonyi, and its rich harvest brought Aboriginal communities together in the Blackall Range. During these gatherings people shared food, performed ceremonies, exchanged knowledge and renewed relationships with neighboring groups.
simp_chinese: 古比古比人又称卡比卡比人，他们的土地位于昆士兰东南部，从沿海河流延伸至内陆森林山脉。邦雅松被称为博尼，其丰收时节吸引原住民社群汇聚到布莱卡尔山脉。聚会期间，人们共享食物、举行仪式、交流知识，并与邻近群体重续联系。

english:
Gubbio climbs the lower slopes of Monte Ingino in the Apennines. The ancient Umbrian town of Ikuvium stood here before Roman rule. Bronze tablets discovered in 1444 preserve a lengthy text in the Umbrian language, a remarkable record of the rituals and institutions of that earlier community.

Gubbio's medieval government was troubled by struggles between local factions and papal authority. Cardinal Albornoz had restored papal authority in 1354, but dissatisfaction with papal government later provoked revolt. After rebellion against papal rule, the city submitted to Count Antonio da Montefeltro in 1387. His successors bound Gubbio to the fortunes of the rulers of Urbino. Under Federico da Montefeltro, a ducal palace was built in the city, adding a Renaissance residence to the older buildings on its steep streets.
simp_chinese:
古比奥沿亚平宁山脉的因吉诺山下坡而建。罗马统治之前，古翁布里亚人的伊库维乌姆城便坐落在此。1444年发现的青铜铭板保存了长篇翁布里亚语文字，为了解这一古代社群的仪式与制度留下了珍贵记录。

古比奥中世纪的政局受到地方派系与教皇权力之间斗争的困扰。1354年，阿尔沃诺斯枢机恢复了教皇的权威，但居民对教皇政府的不满后来引发起义。城市反抗教皇统治后，于1387年归附安东尼奥·达蒙特费尔特罗伯爵。他的继承者使古比奥与乌尔比诺统治者的命运联系在一起。费代里科·达蒙特费尔特罗治下，城中建起一座公爵宫，为陡峭街道上的古老建筑增添了一处文艺复兴时期的府邸。

english: Guben grew on the Neisse in Lower Lusatia, where its market and river crossing attracted merchants and craftsmen. In 1235 Henry the Illustrious, margrave of Meissen, granted the settlement town rights on the model of Magdeburg law. The town shared the changing allegiances of the margravate: from 1367 Lower Lusatia belonged to the Bohemian crown, and in 1635 it passed to Saxony. Guben remained part of Lower Lusatia until the settlement of 1815 brought the region under Prussian rule.
simp_chinese: 古本兴起于下卢萨蒂亚的尼斯河畔，市场和渡河地点吸引了商人及工匠。1235年，迈森藩侯显赫者亨利授予聚落仿照马格德堡法的城市权利。城镇与藩侯领一同经历统治权更迭：1367年起，下卢萨蒂亚属于波希米亚王室，1635年转归萨克森。古本一直是下卢萨蒂亚的一部分，直到1815年的安排使该地区转入普鲁士统治。

english: Gubio lies in the plains of Bornu, west of Lake Chad. The country around it belonged to a kingdom whose rulers and merchants were connected to the Sahara and the central Sudan. Farther west stood Ngazargamu, the capital founded by Mai Ali Gaji in the fifteenth century. Its markets drew caravans from North Africa and neighbouring regions, while the town's fortified walls enclosed the court of Bornu.
simp_chinese: 古比奥位于乍得湖以西的博尔努平原。这一带曾属于博尔努王国，其统治者与商人同撒哈拉及中苏丹各地保持联系。更西面坐落着恩加扎尔加穆，迈阿里·加吉于十五世纪建立的都城。它的市场吸引来自北非和邻近地区的商队，设防城墙内则是博尔努的宫廷。

english: Gǔchéng lies beside the Hàn River in northwestern Húběi. During the turmoil of the late Míng, the rebel leader Zhāng Xiànzhōng accepted an offer of surrender and settled his forces here. In 1638 Lǐ Zìchéng visited him at Gǔchéng; the two discussed taking up arms again, and Zhāng renewed his revolt the following year.
simp_chinese: 谷城位于湖北西北部的汉江畔。明末动乱中，起义首领张献忠接受招抚，将部众安置于此。1638年李自成来到谷城，与他商议再举兵事；次年张献忠重新起兵。

english:
Gucheng lies beside the Grand Canal in the northern Chinese plain. The canal carried grain and other goods between the Yangtze region and the capital, and boats and merchants passed the county on their way north and south. Its waterside settlements became places where goods were collected and exchanged along this important route.

During the Ming and Qing, Gucheng’s position on the canal supported a lively local culture as well as commerce. The county produced writers including Ma Zhongxi and Sun Xu. A local gazetteer described the sails and grain boats passing south of the town, with the sounds of boatmen continuing day and night. The canal brought wealth and travellers to a county whose life was closely tied to the waterway.
simp_chinese:
故城位于华北平原的大运河畔。运河将粮食与其他货物从江南运往京师，船只和商人南来北往，沿水聚落也成为这条重要通道上的货物集散之处。

明清时期，运河带来的商业繁荣也伴随着活跃的地方文化。故城涌现马中锡、孙绪等作家，文风兴盛。地方县志描绘城南帆船与漕舟络绎不绝，船夫的号声和乐声昼夜不停，成为一处壮观的景象。运河将财富与行旅带到这座县城，深刻影响了当地生活。

english: Gucheng is an old place name in the Huai River country of southern Henan. Local tradition connects it with a fortified settlement mentioned in accounts of the struggles between Chu and neighbouring states in the Spring and Autumn period. The surrounding plain is crossed by tributaries of the Huai, with cultivated land and villages spread across its low ground. The name preserves the memory of an old stronghold in this riverine landscape.
simp_chinese: 固城是河南南部淮河流域的古老地名。地方传统将它与春秋时期楚国及邻国争战记载中的一处设防聚落联系起来。淮河支流穿过周围平原，耕地和村落分布在低地上。这个地名保存了河流地带昔日城垒的记忆。

english: Gucheng lies on the Hebei plain east of Zhending. Its name recalls the ancient state of Gu, while the county itself was established under the Sui in 598. It became the seat of Jinzhou under Mongol rule and was absorbed into the prefecture in 1369, early in the Ming dynasty. The change ended the separate county administration, but the old name continued to preserve the memory of the settlement.
simp_chinese: 鼓城位于真定以东的河北平原，地名取自古代鼓国。隋朝于598年改置鼓城县；蒙古统治时期，这里成为晋州治所。明初1369年，鼓城县省入晋州，独立的县治不复存在，旧名却仍保留了这座聚落的记忆。

english: Guchengzi lies in the oasis country north of the eastern Tianshan, east of Beshbalik. Its Chinese name means “old town”, recalling ancient settlements in this corridor between the mountains and the Dzungarian basin. Streams descending from the mountains made cultivation possible along the northern foothills. The surrounding region formed part of the lands contested by Mongol rulers and, after the Qing conquest of Dzungaria, became a place of renewed settlement and trade.
simp_chinese: 古城子位于东天山北麓的绿洲地带，在别失八里以东。地名中的古城二字，留下了这条山麓走廊上古代聚落的记忆。山中溪水流向北方，为山前耕作提供条件。周围地区曾为蒙古诸王争夺，清朝征服准噶尔后，定居与贸易又在这里发展。

english:
Guchuntikka recalls the Guchundeka', the Buffalo Eaters among the Eastern Shoshone. Their country included Wyoming's Green River and Wind River valleys, beside the mountain routes of the northern Rockies. Shoshone expansion had reached the northwestern Plains by about 1500, and the development of an equestrian bison-hunting economy tied these valleys to a much wider grassland world.

This position was contested. Warfare with the Blackfeet, Crow and Assiniboine between about 1780 and 1825 helped shape the Eastern Shoshone's later concentration in central Wyoming. Their seasonal organization allowed families to disperse into smaller winter bands and reunite for collective hunts. Bison meat was especially important in the eighteenth century, complemented by fish, elk, deer, roots and berries. Trade introduced iron for weapons and tools. The Buffalo Eaters' history thus joined mountain-valley resources with hunting, exchange and conflict on the Plains.
simp_chinese:
古春提卡这一名称对应东肖肖尼人的 Guchundeka'，即“食野牛者”。他们的活动地域包括怀俄明的格林河与温德河谷，毗邻北落基山脉的山地通道。约至1500年，肖肖尼人的扩展已抵达平原西北部；骑马猎取野牛的经济发展，又将这些河谷与更广阔的草原世界连接起来。

这一位置也充满争夺。约1780至1825年间与黑脚、克罗和阿西尼博因人的战争，影响了东肖肖尼人后来集中于怀俄明中部的分布。季节性组织使家庭在冬季分散为小群体，再集合进行集体狩猎。十八世纪的野牛肉尤为重要，鱼、马鹿、鹿、块根与浆果则补充食物。贸易还带来制作武器与工具的铁料。“食野牛者”的历史因而将山间河谷资源与平原上的狩猎、交换及冲突联系起来。

english: Gudamalani lies in the Mallani country of western Rajasthan, near the course of the Luni River. The river flows through an arid landscape of sandy ground and thorny vegetation, carrying seasonal water westward towards the salt flats of the Rann of Kutch. Local chiefs of the Rathore lineage held estates in this region, while farming and animal husbandry supported communities along the river and its tributaries.
simp_chinese: 古达马拉尼位于拉贾斯坦西部的马拉尼地区，靠近卢尼河河道。河流穿过沙地和刺生植被构成的干旱景观，将季节性水流向西带往卡奇大盐沼。拉托尔血统的地方首领在这一带掌有领地，河流及其支流沿岸社群则依靠农业和畜牧业生活。

english: Gudur lies in the coastal country south of Nellore, between the Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal. Its surrounding villages formed part of a region of landed estates and temple communities, linked to the inland centres of Venkatagiri and Chandragiri. In the late seventeenth century, a Mughal grant to the Venkatagiri rulers included Gudur among the territories associated with their service. The town stands within the long corridor between the hills and the eastern coast.
simp_chinese: 古杜尔位于内洛尔以南的沿海地区，介于东高止山脉与孟加拉湾之间。周围村落与文卡塔吉里、旃陀罗吉里等内陆中心相连，分布着地主领地和寺庙社群。十七世纪末，莫卧儿授予文卡塔吉里统治者的土地中包括古杜尔。此镇坐落在山地与东海岸之间的狭长通道上。

english: The Gueiquesales were among the Indigenous bands of the northern Coahuila borderlands, where the Río Grande winds between dry uplands. They ranged across the river into the lands south of the Edwards Plateau to hunt and gather. In 1675 Gueiquesale warriors accompanied the Bosque-Larios expedition north of the future site of Eagle Pass, while the expedition encountered other members of the group beyond the river. Their country lay across a waterway that later became an international boundary.
simp_chinese: 格基萨莱斯人是科阿韦拉北部边地的原住民群体之一。这里的格兰德河蜿蜒穿过干燥高地，他们越过河流，到爱德华兹高原以南狩猎和采集。1675年，格基萨莱斯战士陪同博斯克—拉里奥斯探险队前往后来鹰隘所在地点以北，探险队又在河对岸遇见了这一群体的其他成员。他们的活动地域横跨一条后来成为国际边界的河流。

english: Guélengdeng lies beside the Chari River in the southern Lake Chad basin. The river flows north towards the lake through a broad floodplain, where water levels change with the seasons. This is a meeting place of river and savanna landscapes in a region long inhabited by communities along the Chari.
simp_chinese: 盖伦登位于乍得湖盆地南部的沙里河畔。河流向北穿过宽阔泛滥平原，流向乍得湖，水位随季节变化。这里是河流与稀树草原景观交汇之处，沙里河沿岸长期有人群居住。

english: Guelma occupies an inland valley in northeastern Algeria. In Roman times it was known as Calama, a town of Numidia whose remains include a theater. The Christian bishop Possidius held the see in the fifth century, before the Vandal conquest. Byzantine fortifications later enclosed the settlement. The name Guelma belongs to its subsequent history in the Islamic Maghreb, where it lay between the coast and the inland plateaus.
simp_chinese: 盖勒马位于阿尔及利亚东北部的内陆河谷。罗马时代这里称为卡拉马，是努米底亚的一座城镇，留下了剧场等遗迹。五世纪汪达尔人征服之前，基督教主教波西狄乌斯曾在此任职；拜占庭人后来修筑了城墙。盖勒马这一名称属于此地在伊斯兰马格里布的后续历史，它位于海岸和内陆高原之间。

english: Guémé Sangan lies in the western hills of Futa Jalon, a country of wooded slopes and valleys. Here tradition places a fortress of Koli Tenguella, the Fulbe leader whose campaigns carried him from the highlands towards the Senegal valley. Stone remains are associated with the stronghold, recalling a period when rival powers contested the lands between the upper rivers and the Atlantic coast. Koli went on to establish the Denianke dynasty in Futa Toro, far to the north of this highland refuge.
simp_chinese: 格梅桑甘位于富塔贾隆西部丘陵，周围是林木覆盖的山坡与河谷。传说富尔贝领袖科利·滕盖拉曾在这里建造堡垒，从高地向塞内加尔河谷发起征战。当地的石造遗迹与这座要塞相联系，令人想起各方势力争夺河流上游与大西洋海岸之间土地的时代。科利后来在北方遥远的富塔托罗建立了德尼安克王朝。

english:
The Guenoa, also called Minuan in Spanish and Portuguese records, inhabited the country east of the Uruguay River, extending into what is now southern Brazil. Their communities maintained relations with the Jesuit mission towns while retaining leaders and settlements beyond mission control. In 1683 the missionary García visited their territory and encountered several chiefs, including two principal leaders to whom others deferred.

Cattle linked these communities with their neighbours. A contemporary letter describes visitors arriving at Santo Tomé in November 1683 with cows to sell, and some used the journey to learn about life in the mission. Families might enter a mission or leave it again, so the boundary between Christian settlement and independent community remained permeable. In 1732 Minuan representatives and the authorities of Buenos Aires negotiated peace. Indigenous leaders, including those connected with mission communities, helped make such agreements possible. Trade, family decisions and diplomacy therefore shaped Guenoa history alongside the conflicts described in colonial records.
simp_chinese:
格诺亚人在西班牙和葡萄牙文献中也称米努安，居住于乌拉圭河以东，活动范围延伸到今巴西南部。他们与耶稣会传教城镇保持往来，同时在传教区之外维持自己的首领和聚落。1683年，传教士加西亚进入其领地，遇见多位首领，其中两位主要首领得到其他人的服从。

牛群使这些社群与邻近地区相连。当时的一封信记载，1683年十一月，有人带牛来到圣托梅出售，也有人借此了解传教聚落的生活。家庭既可能迁入传教区，也可能离开，使基督教聚落与独立社群之间的界线不断流动。1732年，米努安代表与布宜诺斯艾利斯当局谈判媾和，包括与传教社群相联系者在内的原住民首领，为达成协议发挥了作用。贸易、家庭选择与外交，和殖民文献记载的冲突一样，塑造了格诺亚的历史。

english:
Güentota was the Huarpe valley in which the Spanish founded Mendoza, at the eastern foot of the Andes. Its inhabitants used channels to carry river water to their fields, growing maize and squash in a dry landscape. Indigenous leaders held authority over communities settled around the waterways of the valley, including a principal chief whom chroniclers described as lord of the valley.

Pedro del Castillo founded Mendoza here in 1561, after arriving from Chile. The new city occupied a landscape already shaped by Huarpe agriculture and irrigation. Spanish rule brought tribute and labour demands, and many Huarpes were taken across the mountains to serve in Chile. The channels of the valley nevertheless remained essential to the rapidly growing Spanish colonial settlement.
simp_chinese:
根托塔是安第斯山脉东麓的瓦尔佩河谷，西班牙人后来在此建立门多萨。当地居民用沟渠将河水引至田地，在干旱地带种植玉米和南瓜。原住民首领统辖着沿河谷水道定居的社群，其中一位主要首领被编年史作者称为河谷之主。

1561年，佩德罗·德尔卡斯蒂略从智利来到此地，建立门多萨。新城所在的土地此前已由瓦尔佩人的农业和灌溉设施塑造。西班牙统治带来了贡赋和劳役要求，许多瓦尔佩人被带过群山，到智利服役。河谷的沟渠仍然是不断成长的殖民聚落不可或缺的设施。

english:
Guérande stands within stone walls above the salt marshes of the Breton coast. Seawater is led through shallow basins, where sun and wind leave salt to be gathered and carried to market. The town's gates and church reflect the wealth and importance of this coastal district, whose salt travelled beyond Brittany.

In 1365 the first Treaty of Guérande ended the Breton War of Succession, recognising John of Montfort as duke. The salt marshes remained an important source of ducal revenue and were worked by local salt makers. Abbeys also held rights in the marshes: in 1396 the abbey of Prières obtained exemptions on the transport of salt from its holdings, illustrating the value of the trade to religious houses as well as the duke.
simp_chinese:
盖朗德坐落在布列塔尼海岸盐沼上方，石墙环绕城镇。海水被引入浅池，经日晒风吹留下盐粒，再由人收集运往市场。城门与教堂反映了沿海地区的财富与地位，所产盐远销布列塔尼之外。

1365年，第一份《盖朗德条约》结束布列塔尼王位继承战争，承认蒙福尔的约翰为公爵。盐沼仍是公爵收入的重要来源，由当地盐工经营。修院也拥有盐田权益：1396年，普里埃尔修院获得运输其盐田所产盐的税费豁免，显示这一贸易对宗教机构和公爵都具有价值。

english: Guercif lies in northeastern Morocco at the meeting of the Moulouya and Melloulou rivers. Its position on the routes between the Moroccan interior and the eastern plains made it a place of strategic importance. The surrounding basin is a landscape of cultivated ground and grazing land between the Rif and the Middle Atlas. The river valleys provide natural corridors through this otherwise rugged country.
simp_chinese: 盖尔西夫位于摩洛哥东北部穆卢亚河与梅卢卢河的汇合处。它坐落在摩洛哥内陆与东部平原之间的道路上，因而具有战略意义。周围盆地位于里夫山与中阿特拉斯山之间，分布着耕地和牧场。河谷在这片崎岖地区形成天然通道。

english:
Guéréda belongs to the eastern Sahelian country associated with Wadai, near routes linking the Chad basin and Darfur. Seasonal rainfall supported cultivation in favourable places, while herders used wider grazing lands. Wells, temporary streams and stopping places shaped travel between savanna and drier country. Exchange connected cultivators, pastoralists and merchants.

Wadai developed into an important sultanate in the seventeenth century. Its rulers competed and negotiated with neighbouring states, including Darfur, while Islamic institutions and tribute supported political authority. Caravan routes connected the wider interior with markets toward the Sahara and Nile. Local leaders, herders, farmers and traders all played roles in these regional relationships.
simp_chinese:
盖雷达位于与瓦达伊相联系的东部萨赫勒地带，靠近连接乍得盆地与达尔富尔的道路。季节性降雨使适宜的土地能够耕作，牧民则利用更广阔的草场。水井、季节性河道和停留地点影响穿越草原与干旱地带的路线，交换使农民、牧民和商人保持联系。

十七世纪，瓦达伊发展为重要苏丹国。统治者与达尔富尔等邻国竞争和协商，贡赋与伊斯兰机构支持其权力。商队路线将广大内陆与通往撒哈拉和尼罗河的市场联系起来，地方首领、牧民、农民和商人都参与其中。

english: Guéret became an administrative centre of La Marche amid the hills of central France. The handsome Hôtel des Moneyroux was built after 1447 for Antoine Alard, treasurer of the county, and speaks to the wealth of its officers. In 1515 the formerly itinerant seneschal's court of La Marche acquired permanent seats at Guéret for the upper county and Bellac for the lower, strengthening Guéret's role in the administration of justice.
simp_chinese: 盖雷坐落在法国中部的丘陵之间，逐渐成为拉马什的行政中心。庄丽的莫内鲁府邸于1447年后为伯国财政官安托万·阿拉尔修建，显示了地方官员的财富。1515年，原本巡行各地的拉马什司法机构设立固定治所，上马什设于盖雷，下马什设于贝拉克，进一步巩固了盖雷的司法地位。

english: Guettara lies on the dry southern side of the Saharan Atlas, where the high plateaus give way to the desert. The country is crossed by seasonal watercourses and framed by ridges that separate the Mediterranean-facing lands from the Sahara. Settlements in this region occupy a landscape of sparse vegetation and wide open ground.
simp_chinese: 盖塔拉位于撒哈拉阿特拉斯山脉干燥的南侧，高原在这里逐渐过渡为沙漠。季节性河道穿过这片土地，山脊将面向地中海的地区与撒哈拉隔开。此地聚落坐落在植被稀疏、地势开阔的环境中。

english: Gogera lies in the Punjab plains near the Ravi River, within the dry tract known as the Bar. The river and its floodplain contrast with the more arid land beyond, where pastoral communities have long lived. The settlement stands among the places of the Ravi country, in a region crossed by routes between the river valleys of Punjab. Its name is also written Gugera or Gogaira.
simp_chinese: 古格拉位于旁遮普平原、拉维河附近的巴尔干旱地带。河流与洪泛平原同外围较干燥的土地形成对照，后者长期有牧民社群生活。此地属于拉维河流域的一系列聚落，旁遮普各河谷之间的道路穿过这一地区。其名称亦可写作古盖拉或戈盖拉。

english:
Gugu Badhun country centres on the upper Burdekin River and the Valley of Lagoons in northern Queensland. Before European settlement, it belonged to a community defined by its language, relationships and inherited laws concerning country. Rivers, ranges and lagoons formed a named landscape in which rights of access were attached to people and places. Knowledge passed through families connected residence and travel to responsibilities toward the land.

Oral histories describe close relationships with northern and southern neighbours, alongside more restricted movement across some bordering ranges. Travellers could need permission to enter another people's country. Linguistic and cultural ties permitted interaction without making every route freely accessible. These accounts reveal a landscape organised by recognised relationships and limits as well as by physical terrain. Gugu Badhun history before the arrival of European explorers consequently includes enduring ownership, communication and obligations between neighbouring communities. The inherited connection to the upper Burdekin was established before 1788, long before pastoral settlement transformed the region.
simp_chinese:
古古巴顿人的地域以昆士兰北部伯德金河上游和潟湖谷为中心。欧洲殖民以前，当地社群通过语言、亲缘与继承的土地习惯法相联系。河流、山脉和潟湖构成有名称的景观，通行权与具体人群、地点相连；家庭传授的知识，也将居住和旅行同照管土地的责任结合。

口述史描述了与南北邻族的密切往来，以及跨越某些边界山脉时受到的限制。进入其他人群的地域，有时需要事先获得许可。语言、文化联系促进交往，也没有使所有路线都可任意通行。这些记忆呈现出由社会关系、权利界限及自然地形共同组织的地域。在欧洲考察者到来以前，古古巴顿人已有延续的土地归属、交流方式和邻族义务；对伯德金河上游的联系早在1788年以前便已建立。

english: Guguan rises from the Pacific in the northern Mariana Islands, its volcanic slopes surrounded by deep water. The sea links this island chain to the inhabited islands farther south. Spanish voyages entered the Mariana Islands in the sixteenth century, long after the archipelago had been settled by Chamorro people.
simp_chinese: 古关岛从北马里亚纳群岛的太平洋中升起，火山山坡周围是深水。海洋将这列岛屿与更南方有人居住的岛屿连接起来。西班牙船只于十六世纪进入马里亚纳群岛，此前查莫罗人早已在群岛定居。

english: Guhlkahéndé, “people of the plains,” is a name associated with an eastern Mescalero Apache group. Their range extended across the high plains east of the Pecos River and toward the Llano Estacado, linking mountain country with the grasslands of New Mexico and western Texas. They hunted and travelled across a broad region where relationships with other Apache groups and neighbouring plains peoples shaped access to territory and resources.
simp_chinese: 古尔卡亨德意为“平原之民”，是与东部梅斯卡莱罗阿帕奇群体相关的名称。其活动范围横跨佩科斯河以东的高平原，延伸至利亚诺埃斯塔卡多，将山地与新墨西哥、得克萨斯西部的草原联系起来。他们在广阔地区狩猎和旅行，与其他阿帕奇群体及邻近平原民族的关系影响着地域与资源的利用。

english: The forested mountain country of Guhu-Samane lies inland from the southern coast of Papua New Guinea. Guhu-Samane is a Papuan language associated with the Waria River region. Its relationship with neighbouring languages reflects a landscape of valleys and ridges where communities have long been connected across the mountains.
simp_chinese: 古胡萨马内的森林山区位于巴布亚新几内亚南岸内陆。古胡萨马内语是与瓦里亚河地区有关的巴布亚语言。它与邻近语言的关系反映出山谷与山脊交错的景观，当地社群长期跨越山地保持联系。

english: The Gǀui are a people of the central Kalahari, neighbours of the Gǁana and speakers of a related language. In their country, shallow pans can hold rainwater for a short time and attract animals; their margins serve as places to camp, hunt and gather. Gǀui knowledge distinguishes these basins within a landscape of sand and grass where surface water is scarce for much of the year.
simp_chinese: 圭人生活在卡拉哈里中部，与格哈纳人为邻，双方语言关系密切。当地浅洼在雨后能短暂蓄水，吸引动物前来；洼地边缘也是人们扎营、狩猎和采集的地方。圭人认识并区分这些盆地，它们散布在大半时间缺少地表水的沙地与草原之间。

sources.title: 252295607 Explaining Pathways in the Central Kalahari

english: The Guiaquitas were one of the Indigenous groups associated with the Concho peoples of northern Mexico. Their name appears in colonial accounts alongside those of the Baopapas, Julimes and other communities of the Río Conchos region. In testimony recorded in 1684, a Concho leader named the Guiaquitas among the groups he had led. Their country lay within a wider frontier of rivers, mountains and desert basins where Spanish missions and mines expanded during the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 吉亚基塔斯人是墨西哥北部与孔乔民族相关的原住民群体之一。殖民记录将他们与巴奥帕帕斯、胡利梅斯等孔乔河地区社群并列。1684年，一位孔乔首领在证词中将吉亚基塔斯人列为自己曾领导的群体之一。他们的土地属于河流、山脉和沙漠盆地交错的广大边疆；十七世纪，西班牙传教站和矿区在这一地区扩展。

english: Guichen Bay opens onto the Southern Ocean on the southeastern coast of Australia. Sandy shores and reefs border the bay, with coastal lakes and low limestone country inland. In 1802 the French expedition of Nicolas Baudin charted this part of the coast while Matthew Flinders surveyed neighbouring waters farther west.
simp_chinese: 吉尚湾位于澳大利亚东南岸，向南大洋敞开。沙岸与礁石环绕海湾，内陆分布沿海湖泊和低矮石灰岩地带。1802年，尼古拉·博丹率领的法国远征队测绘这一段海岸，马修·弗林德斯则在更西方测绘邻近水域。

english:
Guichi stands on the south bank of the Yangtze, beneath the hills of southern Anhui. As the seat of Chizhou, it commands a landscape of lakes, streams and hills between the river and the mountains. The Tang poet Du Mu served here and left verses that later generations associated with the local scenery.

In the Ming and Qing, visitors celebrated ten scenic places around the city. Among them were the caves of Qi Mountain, moonlight on Clear Stream and the wine shops of Apricot Blossom Village outside the city gate. Local gazetteers preserved poems about the village, linking its taverns with Du Mu's famous verse about a shepherd boy pointing a traveller toward a place to drink.
simp_chinese:
贵池位于长江南岸、皖南群山之北，是池州府治。江水与山地之间，湖泊、溪流和丘陵交错。唐代诗人杜牧曾在池州任职，留下不少诗文，后人常将他的诗句与当地风物相联系。

明清时，城郊有“池阳十景”之称，包括齐山洞天、清溪夜月和城外的杏村酒旆。地方志保存了吟咏杏花村的诗篇，将村中酒家与杜牧笔下牧童遥指酒处的名句联系起来。

english:
Guichita was a Spanish form of the name Wichita, applied to a people of the southern Plains. Wichita communities cultivated maize, beans and squash near grass-covered houses, while hunting parties followed bison across the prairie. Their language belonged to the Caddoan family, and their relatives included the Taovaya, Tawakoni and Waco.

In 1541 Francisco Vázquez de Coronado reached the Wichita country of Quivira in search of a wealthy land described to him by guides. Sixty years later Juan de Oñate encountered another large settlement on the southern Plains, whose people the Spaniards called Rayados. During the eighteenth century Wichita groups moved southward into Oklahoma and Texas, where they traded and negotiated with French and Spanish visitors while maintaining their own villages.
simp_chinese:
吉奇塔是威奇托之名的一种西班牙语形式，指生活在南部平原的民族。威奇托社群在覆草房屋附近种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，猎队则在草原上追逐野牛。他们的语言属于卡多语族，亲缘群体包括陶瓦亚、塔瓦科尼和瓦科人。

1541年，弗朗西斯科·巴斯克斯·德·科罗纳多寻找向导所描述的富庶之地时抵达威奇托人的基维拉地区。六十年后，胡安·德·奥尼亚特在南部平原遇到另一处大型聚落，西班牙人称其居民为拉亚多斯。十八世纪，威奇托各群体向南迁往俄克拉何马和得克萨斯，在保有自身村落的同时与法国及西班牙来访者贸易和谈判。

english: Guide lies in a high valley of the Yellow River, west of the road from Xining toward the Tibetan Plateau. Its fields occupy a sheltered basin among the mountains, with the river flowing east through the district. In the early Ming, troops built an earthen town here and established a military post; construction of the walls was completed in 1380. The fortified settlement guarded routes between the agricultural valleys and the highlands, while local communities continued to live along the river and its tributaries.
simp_chinese: 贵德位于黄河高谷，地处西宁通往青藏高原的道路以西。山间盆地较为避风，田地分布其间，黄河向东流过。明初军士在此筑土城、设守御所，城墙于1380年完工。城堡守卫农耕河谷与高地之间的道路，地方居民则沿河及支流生活。

english: Guidimouni is an oasis settlement beside a lake east of Zinder, in the Sahelian country of Damagaram. Local tradition recalls its settlement by Kanuri from Bornu in the tenth century. The lake and its surrounding wetland stand out among the dry lands of the region, while the neighbouring communities include Dagra, a Kanuri group whose livelihood combines cultivation and animal husbandry.
simp_chinese: 吉迪穆尼是津德尔以东的一处湖畔绿洲，位于萨赫勒的达马加拉姆地区。当地传说记得，十世纪时来自博尔努的卡努里人在这里定居。湖泊及其周边湿地在干燥的土地中格外醒目，附近居民包括达格拉人这一卡努里支系，他们的生计兼有耕作与畜牧。

english:
Guidong lies among the Luoxiao Mountains on the border of Hunan and Jiangxi. Its high ridges and valleys belong to a country shaped by movement across the provincial boundary. Many families trace their origins to migrants from Jiangxi, and Hakka speech is heard alongside other varieties of Chinese in the mountain districts.

A county was established here under the Southern Song. After the fall of that dynasty, Li Rongmen, formerly in the service of the Song minister Wen Tianxiang, withdrew to Guidong from Haozhou. His descendants remained in the district for generations. In 1678, during the revolt of Wu Sangui, the county was briefly renamed Yangping to avoid using a character in Wu's personal name; the old name was restored the following year.
simp_chinese:
桂东位于湘赣交界的罗霄山中，群峰与河谷构成了这片山地的面貌。历代江西移民翻山而来，不少家族的先祖来自东边；山间除了其他汉语方言，也能听到客家话。

南宋时，这里设立了县治。宋亡后，曾在文天祥麾下任职的李荣门自濠州迁居桂东，隐居山中，其后代世居于此。1678年吴三桂反清称帝，县名为避其名讳中的“桂”字，一度改为阳平；次年又恢复桂东旧名。

english: Guihua lay in the mountainous country of Yiliang, between Wumeng and Zhenxiong. A hereditary chieftaincy was established here under the Ming and placed under the chiefs of Zhenxiong. Its valleys and villages formed part of a wider frontier of Yi and other communities, where local rulers held office under imperial authority. In the eighteenth century Qing reforms replaced the chieftaincy with officials appointed through the provincial administration.
simp_chinese: 归化位于乌蒙与镇雄之间的彝良山区。明代这里设世袭长官司，隶属镇雄土司。当地河谷和村寨属于彝族及其他社群共同生活的边地，地方首领在朝廷名义下任职。十八世纪清代改土归流，以省府任命的官员取代土司。

english: Guiigu Yudxi, the Zapotec name for Jalapa del Marqués, lies in the valleys of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec. Its name has been interpreted as “river of sand.” The settlement was an important town of the Zapotec kingdom of Tehuantepec, and a Dominican convent was built there during the sixteenth century. Its church stood as a landmark of the colonial town and the spread of Christianity through the isthmus.
simp_chinese: 吉古尤德希是哈拉帕德尔马尔克斯的萨波特克语名称，位于特万特佩克地峡的谷地中。名称被解释为“沙河”。聚落曾是萨波特克特万特佩克王国的重要城镇，十六世纪多明我会在此修建修道院。教堂成为殖民城镇及基督教在地峡传播的地标。

english: Guildford stands on the River Wey where it cuts through the North Downs. A royal castle overlooked the medieval town, whose market drew produce and cloth from the surrounding countryside. Guildford was especially known for a coarse woollen cloth dyed blue with woad. Guildford blue found buyers across western Europe and brought prosperity to the town, a connection recalled by the woolpacks in its borough arms.
simp_chinese: 吉尔福德位于韦伊河穿过北唐斯丘陵之处。王室城堡俯瞰着中世纪城镇，周围乡村的农产品和布匹在市场上交易。吉尔福德尤其以用菘蓝染成蓝色的粗毛呢闻名。这种“吉尔福德蓝”远销西欧，为城镇带来财富；市镇纹章上的羊毛包也让人记起这段渊源。

sources.title: Guildford town centre CAA low res .pdf

english:
Guiling lay northeast of Hezhou, beneath the ridge from which the county took its name. Roads through this corner of Guangxi approached the neighbouring lands of Hunan and Guangdong. An old county seat had developed here under earlier dynasties, and Guiling remained a county within Hezhou during the Yuan. Its separate county administration disappeared at the end of that dynasty, but the place continued to matter within the territory administered from Hezhou and later He County.

Military organisation gave Guiling a renewed role in the late Ming. During the Wanli reign, a main camp was established at this strategically placed site, with a shoubei officer stationed there and responsibilities extending across thirteen subsidiary camps. A Qing geographical account records that soldiers were subsequently distributed among eight surviving posts, including Guiling, Laicun, Tingxie and Longshui, while the others had been abolished. The former county landscape therefore remained linked to the maintenance of routes and local security. Its history runs from an administrative centre to a garrison network across the hills, where a settlement's importance could outlast the county institution that had once occupied it.
simp_chinese:
桂岭位于贺州东北，以境内山岭得名，山间道路通向邻近的湖南与广东。早期王朝已在此发展县治，元代桂岭仍为贺州属县。元末，独立县级建置被撤销，但这一地点继续处于贺州及后来贺县管辖的土地之内。

明代后期，军事机构赋予桂岭新的作用。万历年间，官府在这一适中的要地建立大营，派守备驻守，统辖十三处分营。清代地理记载称，后来军队分驻桂岭、赖村、停歇、龙水等八处营地，其余已废。旧县域由此仍与道路维持和地方防卫紧密相连。桂岭的历史经历了从行政中心到山地驻防网络的变化，县制虽已结束，原有地点的重要性仍然延续。

english: Guimarães occupies a celebrated place in the beginnings of Portugal. In the tenth century Countess Mumadona Dias founded a monastery in the lower settlement and built a castle on the hill above it. The monastery acquired royal and noble gifts and became a place of pilgrimage. Nearby, the battle of São Mamede in 1128 marked an important step in Afonso Henriques's rise to power and the formation of the Portuguese kingdom. The medieval town grew around its religious and fortified centers. Mendicant orders established themselves here, and walls protected the expanding settlement. Guimarães also had a Jewish community with its own communal institutions; after Manuel I's decree of 1496, Jews were required to convert or leave Portugal.
simp_chinese: 吉马良斯在葡萄牙的起源史上占有显赫地位。十世纪，穆马多娜·迪亚斯伯爵夫人在下镇创建修道院，又在上方的山丘修筑城堡。修道院获得王室和贵族的捐赠，成为朝圣之地。附近于1128年发生的圣马梅德战役，是阿方索·恩里克斯掌权和葡萄牙王国形成过程中的重要一步。中世纪城镇围绕宗教中心和堡垒发展，托钵修会在此落脚，城墙保护着不断扩大的聚落。吉马良斯还有拥有自己社群机构的犹太社区；1496年曼努埃尔一世颁令之后，犹太人必须改宗或离开葡萄牙。

english:
The Gulf of Guinea opened West Africa's coastal markets to Atlantic shipping, while African canoe crews linked ships offshore with communities beyond the surf. On its northern shore, the Bight of Benin connected lagoon routes and inland roads with ports such as Ouidah. Food, cloth and imported manufactures passed through these markets alongside the captives whose forced embarkation made the coast a centre of the Atlantic slave trade.

Ouidah first prospered under the Hueda kingdom. In 1727 Dahomey conquered it, gaining a maritime outlet through which royal officials and African merchants dealt with European traders. Forts and trading establishments represented competing foreign interests, but access to supplies and inland sellers remained dependent on African intermediaries. Captives reached the shore through warfare, kidnapping and successive sales, before being carried across the ocean. British prohibition of its own slave trade in 1807 did not immediately end this traffic: commerce through the Bight continued under other flags and illicit arrangements. By the early nineteenth century, these waters joined local maritime labour to a long-distance trading system whose wealth depended heavily on dispossession and enslavement.
simp_chinese:
几内亚湾将西非沿岸市场接入大西洋航运，非洲独木舟船员往来外海船只与浪岸内侧社群之间。北岸贝宁湾的潟湖航道和内陆道路通向维达等港口。粮食、布匹和进口制品在市场流通，被迫登船的俘虏则使这段海岸成为大西洋奴隶贸易的重要中心。

维达最初在韦达王国治下兴盛。1727年达荷美征服此地，取得海上出口，王室官员与非洲商人在此同欧洲交易者接洽。各国堡垒和商馆代表不同外来利益，货源、补给和内陆卖主仍需非洲中介联络。战俘、遭绑架者及多次转卖的被奴役者来到海岸，随后被运过大洋。英国1807年禁止本国奴隶贸易，并未立即终止这种运输，其他旗帜下及非法安排中的交易仍继续穿越贝宁湾。至十九世纪初，本地海上劳作与跨洋贸易体系紧密相接，而其中大量财富来自对人口的剥夺与奴役。

english: This stretch of Upper Guinean forest lies near the Cavally River and the forests of Taï. Tall trees and dense undergrowth shelter pygmy hippopotamuses, forest elephants and several kinds of monkey, including the Diana monkey. The Cavally flows southwards towards the Atlantic, while its tributaries cut through the wooded country. Farther east, the Sassandra marks the other side of the Taï forest region.
